meta.name: commandery-county-administration
meta.description: Use when replacing feudal states with centralized commandery-county (郡县) administration. Establishes 36 commanderies with three-tier governance (守/尉/监), merit-based appointments, and centralized treasury stipends per Li Si's rationale.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将封建制改为郡县制，建立中央集权行政体系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在模拟或研究秦代郡县制改革与中央集权行政体系
copy.tagline_en: Replace feudal states with centralized commandery-county administration
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are simulating or studying Qin dynasty administrative reform

howto.what: 安装后，当你要求建立郡县制时，Claude会指导你废除封建制、划分36郡，并任命按功绩选拔的守、尉、监三级官员，所有俸禄由中央国库发放。
howto.when: 当你提出要取代封建制、建立中央集权的郡县行政体系时触发。

say.text: 废除所有诸侯国，改为郡县制。
按功绩任命郡守、郡尉和监御史。
所有官员俸禄由中央国库发放。

howto.what_en: When installed, if you request to establish a commandery-county system, Claude guides you to abolish feudalism, divide into 36 commanderies, appoint merit-based governors, commandants, and inspectors, with stipends from the imperial treasury.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to replace feudal states with centralized commandery-county administration.

say_en.text: Abolish all feudal states and switch to commandery-county system.
Appoint governors, commandants, and inspectors based on merit.
All official stipends come from the imperial treasury.
